release_notes: Build 126 adds post-release Instagram promo follow-through: when Autopilot is ON, Factburst verifies the full YouTube quiz is actually public and then publishes the prepared Instagram Reel automatically.

Automatic Instagram publishing only uses an already-approved Facebook Page / linked Instagram destination. Missing approval, account-link problems, missing promo files and upload failures are recorded and surfaced in Needs You instead of disappearing.
Needs You now includes recent public YouTube quizzes whose Instagram promo is still missing and provides a dedicated Post Instagram promo action for manual fallback.
Library now shows compact YT, FB and IG full-quiz publication columns plus a separate IG promo column with Waiting, Posted, Needs upload or Promo missing state.
Library platform state refreshes while Library is open and reconciles existing publication records so older quizzes gain the same status view.
